captions: 1547: a family research note records a 1,000-year lease of 'Cydwin' from Sir George Herbert to Vaughan; the lease itself is not yet found (EV-0002)
1552–1824: a family research note gives the holding as 'Cedfin / Cydfin / Ken fin Farm or Ty Mawr Farm' in Bute estate records; the documents are not yet produced (EV-0003)
1667: Williams family occupancy begins, as Mary Buckler later recounted; an earlier written source is awaited (CH-0003)
moment.basis: Estate plans dated 1786–1832 of lands in Cogan, Llandough, Penarth, St Andrews Major and Sully survive in the Percy Randell collection (CH-0004). The survey day, the chain-man and the year c. 1786 are inferred as the most likely moment.
